label: Sample — XYZ-JPY vs USDJPY (10x)
description: The settings ATJ Research runs on XYZ-JPY/USDC:USDC vs MT5 USDJPY (exported 2026-10-05), sized down to one MT5 minimum lot per level: 2 grid levels per side every 0.04 around a center of -0.08, 6.5 units per level and per order (about 1,000 USDC: one 0.01-lot USDJPY hedge while USDJPY is above 153.8), caps 19.5 long / 19.5 short (the two levels plus 50% head-room for a USDJPY move), 10x isolated, no limit optimisation offset, daily loss 100 USD, daily volume 25,000 USD. Start it in DRY RUN; Save checks every size against the market the bot reports. Trading hours: FX 24/5 in New York time, with no quotes 16:55-17:05 around the daily rollover and from Friday 16:55 to Sunday 17:05.

descriptions.GRID_STEP: Distance between two grid levels, in spread points (or bps with SPREAD_UNIT = 'bps').
descriptions.GRID_LEVELS: How many grid levels the bot quotes on each side of the center.
descriptions.ORDER_VOLUME: Size of each resting order, in base units; None = one level's whole exposure.
descriptions.GRID_CENTER: Spread the grid is centered on; 0 = the first buy one step below, the first sell one step above.
descriptions.GRID_TAKE_PROFIT: How far from its entry a level is closed, in spread points; None = one grid step.
descriptions.GRID_DIRECTION: Which side the grid enters: both, long only or short only. Exits always run.
descriptions.GRID_LEVEL_UNITS: Exposure per grid level, in base units of the quoting symbol (unused while dynamic allocation is on).
descriptions.CLOSE_ONLY: True = wind down: no new entries, only exits.
descriptions.BASIS_TRIGGER: True = an order is sent only once the averaged basis reaches its level, instead of resting all the time.
descriptions.BASIS_WINDOW_S: Seconds the basis is averaged over for the trigger.
descriptions.BASIS_RELEASE: Hysteresis, in spread points: how far the basis must fall back before an armed order is pulled.
descriptions.OPTIMIZE_LIMIT_OFFSET: Prices a triggered order this far off the basis average, in spread points, instead of at its level; None = off.
descriptions.OPTIMIZE_LIMIT_TAKER: Apply that limit optimisation to taker orders too (False = a taker order is priced at its level).
descriptions.REQUOTE_MIN_MOVE: How far, in spread points, a target price must move before the order is re-quoted; 0 = every tick.
descriptions.ORDER_OPS_PER_S: Order budget: order calls per second, sustained; None = the venue default.
descriptions.ORDER_OPS_BURST: Order budget: how many order calls may go out at once before the sustained rate applies.
descriptions.ALLOW_TAKER_ENTRY: Allow entries to take liquidity (False = post-only maker).
descriptions.ALLOW_TAKER_EXIT: Allow exits to take liquidity (False = post-only maker).
descriptions.BUY_MAX_SPREAD: Entries only while the spread is at or above this, in spread points; None = no floor.
descriptions.SELL_MIN_SPREAD: Entries only while the spread is at or below this, in spread points; None = no ceiling.
descriptions.FUNDING_RATE_MAX_ABS: No new entries while |funding rate| per hour is above this; None = off.
descriptions.ORACLE_BASIS_FILTER: True = no new entries while the exchange's oracle drifts from the reference price.
descriptions.ORACLE_BASIS_MAX: The largest |oracle − reference| allowed, in spread points; None = off.
descriptions.MT5_DEVIATION_POINTS: Maximum slippage, in MT5 points, on a hedge market order.
descriptions.MT5_COMMENT: Comment on the hedge orders; empty = "hedge <strategy key>".
descriptions.RECONCILE_INTERVAL_S: Seconds between two parity checks of the venue position against the MT5 hedge.
descriptions.RECONCILE_RECHECK_DELAY_S: Seconds the parity check waits and reads again before it repairs a gap.
descriptions.MT5_STALE_S: A hedge quote frozen longer than this many seconds counts as a closed session.
descriptions.MIN_MARGIN_LEVEL_MT5: No new entries below this MT5 margin level (%); 0 = off.
descriptions.MIN_MT5_FREE_MARGIN_OPEN: No new entries below this MT5 free margin (account currency).
descriptions.PLACE_MARGIN_SAFETY: Perpetuals: an entry is refused when notional / leverage × this exceeds the available margin.
descriptions.MAX_DAILY_LOSS_USD: Daily loss that switches the bot to close-only for the rest of the day; None = off.
descriptions.DERISK_MT5_MARGIN_LEVEL: Reduce the position below this MT5 margin level (%); None = off.
descriptions.DERISK_MT5_FREE_MARGIN: Reduce the position below this MT5 free margin (account currency); None = off.
descriptions.SESSION_REOPEN_BLACKOUT_MIN: Minutes of no quoting after the hedge market reopens; 0 = off.
descriptions.BLACKOUT_TZ: Timezone the trading hours, breaks, holidays and events are read in; None = ACP's timezone.
descriptions.SESSION_MON: Monday's quoting hours (e.g. 08:00-22:00); closed = no trading; None = no limit.
descriptions.SESSION_TUE: Tuesday's quoting hours (e.g. 08:00-22:00); closed = no trading; None = no limit.
descriptions.SESSION_WED: Wednesday's quoting hours (e.g. 08:00-22:00); closed = no trading; None = no limit.
descriptions.SESSION_THU: Thursday's quoting hours (e.g. 08:00-22:00); closed = no trading; None = no limit.
descriptions.SESSION_FRI: Friday's quoting hours (e.g. 08:00-22:00); closed = no trading; None = no limit.
descriptions.SESSION_SAT: Saturday's quoting hours (e.g. 08:00-22:00); closed = no trading; None = no limit.
descriptions.SESSION_SUN: Sunday's quoting hours (e.g. 08:00-22:00); closed = no trading; None = no limit.
descriptions.BREAK_MARKETS: Which markets' rows of the events calendar pause this strategy (e.g. US EU); None = the hedge symbol's.
descriptions.BREAK_ASSET_CLASS: Calendar rows naming asset classes pause it only for this class; None = the hedge symbol's class.
descriptions.MARKET_OPEN_BREAKS: True = pause quoting around the Tokyo, London and New York opens (Mon-Fri).
descriptions.MARKET_OPEN_BREAK_MIN: Minutes before and after each market open that the pause lasts.
descriptions.HOLIDAYS: Market holidays: whole days or hours on which no quotes rest.
descriptions.BLACKOUT_BEFORE_MIN: Default minutes of no quoting before a calendar event or daily blackout.
descriptions.BLACKOUT_AFTER_MIN: Default minutes of no quoting after a calendar event or daily blackout.
descriptions.DAILY_BREAKS: Daily windows ("HH:MM", label, minutes before, after) with no quoting, e.g. the rollover.
descriptions.MACRO_EVENTS: Dated macro events ("YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM", label, minutes before, after) with no quoting around them.
descriptions.HEDGE_THRESHOLD_UNITS: Unhedged exposure, in base units, before a hedge is sent; None = one MT5 minimum lot.
descriptions.RECONCILE_TOLERANCE_UNITS: Gap between the two legs, in base units, that the parity check accepts; None = one MT5 minimum lot.
descriptions.MARGIN_MODE: Margin mode set on the quoting exchange: isolated or cross.
descriptions.LEVERAGE: Leverage set on the quoting exchange at bot start; None = leave the account's.
descriptions.MAX_POSITION_UNITS: Largest long position, in base units; None = uncapped (ignored while dynamic allocation is on).
descriptions.MAX_SHORT_UNITS: Largest short position, in base units (a positive size).
descriptions.SPREAD_UNIT: abs = price-gap settings are in the pair's own price points; bps = basis points of the quoting price.
descriptions.BPS_REANCHOR_WAIT_H: bps only: hours to wait after the day rolls for a break in quoting before re-anchoring.
descriptions.BPS_REANCHOR_DRIFT_PCT: bps only: also re-anchor when the price moves this far (%) from the anchor; None = daily only.
descriptions.DYNAMIC_ALLOCATION: True = the position caps follow the account equity (ALLOCATION_PCT) instead of the fixed caps.
descriptions.ALLOCATION_PCT: Dynamic caps: min(quoting, hedging equity) × this % × leverage / mid, per side; None = off.
descriptions.ALLOCATION_REFRESH_S: Seconds between two recomputations of the dynamic caps.
descriptions.MIN_VENUE_AVAILABLE_MARGIN_USD: No new entries below this available margin on the quoting exchange (USD, perpetuals).
descriptions.MAX_DAILY_VOLUME_USD: Daily traded notional (USD) on either exchange that switches the bot to close-only; None = off.
descriptions.DERISK_VENUE_AVAILABLE_MARGIN_USD: Reduce the position below this available margin on the quoting exchange (USD); None = off.
descriptions.DERISK_VENUE_LIQ_DISTANCE_PCT: Reduce the position below this distance to liquidation (%, see LIQ_DISTANCE_BASE); None = off.
descriptions.LIQ_DISTANCE_BASE: How the liquidation distance is measured: entry = share of the entry-to-liquidation cushion left; mark = % of the mark price.
descriptions.RISK_UNIT: abs = the daily loss and margin floors are amounts; % = percentages of the capital.
